name: Spectral human hero relief
suitability: Suitable for frontal relief; not a 360-degree reconstruction.

observations.silhouette: Organic bust; irregular short hair, visible left-image ear, long dark neck, broad cropped shoulders.
observations.surface: Black/navy body with blue rim, vertical cyan/white and warm spectral face streaks; four small white highlights down the center.
observations.hidden: Actual nose, eyes, rear skull and shoulders are not measurable behind the optical light. Depth is an authored approximation, not estimated anatomy.

pipeline: separate bust and upper-neck head pivot with three inherited face/optical groups
GSAP ticker with unchanged entrance and scroll

skillAdaptations.projection: Follow projection-first source fidelity; use unlit source radiance, not PBR albedo, so de-lighting would destroy the explicitly required spectral illumination.
skillAdaptations.geometry: User explicitly requests a 2.5D surface, superseding code-only full character, hair generation, rigging, explodable parts, rear turntable and strict full-sculpt factory requirements.
skillAdaptations.review: Review 9 degree head yaw / 4.5 degree pitch, 2.6/1.3 degree bust response and small inherited face/optical additions; 80 percent range for touch/compact screens. No full orbit. Inspect head silhouette as well as face.

critical: no pale rectangle or mask halo
failures: touch drag unavailable or vertical scrolling blocked
